label: Promises and agency changes give reliance different consequences
explanation: Drennan limits revocation of a subcontractor’s bid in light of foreseeable justified reliance in that setting. Fox explains that an agency changing policy must address serious reliance interests and contrary prior factual findings when those features require a fuller explanation. Fox did not hold that broadcasters had proved promise-based liability. Its analysis creates no contract, automatic damages remedy, or irrevocable regulatory policy.
